newsitem.title: USA: Trimas to redeem issue for cash.
newsitem.headline: Trimas to redeem issue for cash.

text.p: TriMas Corp said Tuesday it will redeem for cash on March 21, 1997 its outstanding issue of $115.0 million of five percent convertible subordinated debentures due 2003.
The issue will be redeemed at a price of $1,033.30 plus accrued interest of $6.94 per $1,000 debenture.

The debentures are convertible through the close of business on March 20, 1997 into shares of TriMas common stock at a conversion price of $22-5/8 per share or about 44.2 common shares per $1,000 debenture, TriMas said in a statement.
Debentures surrendered for conversion will not be entitled to receive the dividend payable on the company's common stock on February 18, 1997.
